feedback_summary: The script demonstrates an attempt to describe the chart and identify the highest and lowest sources of electricity. However, it suffers from inaccurate data reporting (Coal at 49% and Hydro-electric at 18%), persistent spelling errors, sentence fragments, and unnecessary repetition in the concluding paragraph. External speculation regarding production costs is also introduced. The script falls into Band 2 with a total score of 4/10.
